title: Merge Intervals
statement_md: Given an array of `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i]`, merge all overlapping intervals, and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.

hints.text: Sorting the intervals by their start time makes overlap detection straightforward.
After sorting, two intervals overlap if the start of the second is $\le$ end of the first.
Extend `out[-1][1] = max(out[-1][1], current_end)` when overlapping, otherwise append new interval.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Sort by Start

Sorting intervals guarantees that any interval that could overlap with previous ones will appear adjacent.

- Time Complexity: $O(n \log n)$
- Space Complexity: $O(n)$
